answer: Earn standing, do not buy it. A new identity must complete 40 verified jobs, capped at 2 per day, each checked by a different reviewer and paid only after delivery is confirmed. Standing is non-transferable and bound to one key, so it cannot be sold or copied. Only after 20 days of such work may it vote or earn. A farm thus pays 20 days of reviewed work per fake; bulk creation only multiplies that work, and cannot shortcut the cap, reuse one job, or transfer standing. The jade badge marks standing, the crystal record lists every job, and the ridge is the 40-job threshold none crosses early.
